findings.title: Public approval derived from the manifest's own release block
findings.message: The public check only validates that the release audit field is approved. It does not verify that the release metadata is the authoritative, hash-bound one, so a forged manifest with consistent hashes can self-declare approval. check-sdk's verify_archive trusts the manifest's own release block, so the approval gate is circular.
findings.suggestion: Treat the manifest release block as untrusted. Also require a trusted external approval (such as an expected audit status or a signed value) to be passed to verify_archive, or document that the check is only consistency-level.
findings.evidence: if not private_build and (type(release_metadata) is not dict or release_metadata.get("third_party_distribution_audit") != "approved" or "component_notices" not in record):
